title: Inversion et emphase
goal: Mettre en valeur une idée importante.
points: Après « Not only », « Never », « Rarely » en début de phrase, on inverse auxiliaire et sujet : « Not only did they pay late… »
« Never have we… » = jamais nous n'avons… : « Never have we lost a container. »
La phrase clivée « What we need is… » met une idée en avant : « What we need is a reliable carrier. »
« It was … who/that… » insiste sur un élément : « It was the driver who found the leak. »
examples: Not only is our service fast, but it is also cheaper.
Non seulement notre service est rapide, mais il est aussi moins cher.
Never have we missed a delivery to Ouagadougou.
Jamais nous n'avons manqué une livraison à Ouagadougou.
What our clients want is transparency.
Ce que veulent nos clients, c'est la transparence.
It was Mrs Okafor who negotiated the deal.
C'est Mme Okafor qui a négocié l'accord.

options: Never we have seen such delays.
Never have we seen such delays.
Never we saw such delays.
Never have seen we such delays.
exercises.explain: Après « Never » en début de phrase, on inverse : auxiliaire + sujet (« have we »).

exercises.sentence: Not only ___ they deliver late, but they also lost two pallets.
options: did
they
were
have
exercises.explain: Au passé simple, l'inversion se fait avec « did » : « Not only did they deliver late ».

exercises.audio: What we need is a reliable carrier.
options: What we need is a reliable carrier.
What we need is a reliable career.
What we need are reliable carriers.
We need a reliable carrier.
exercises.explain: « What we need is… » met en valeur l'idée principale. « carrier » = transporteur.

exercises.fr: C'est le chauffeur qui a trouvé la fuite.
exercises.answer: It was the driver who found the leak
exercises.explain: « It was … who … » insiste sur la personne qui a fait l'action.

exercises.sentence: Rarely ___ a shipment cleared customs so quickly.
options: has
have
it has
is
exercises.explain: Après « Rarely », inversion : « has a shipment cleared » (sujet singulier).

exercises.prompt: Pour insister sur la ponctualité dans une présentation, tu dis :
options: What makes us different is our punctuality.
What makes us different our punctuality is.
That makes us different is our punctuality.
What does make us different is our punctuality is.
exercises.explain: La phrase clivée « What makes us different is… » met en avant l'argument clé.

exercises.fr: Jamais nous n'avons perdu un conteneur.
exercises.answer: Never have we lost a container
exercises.explain: « Never » en tête de phrase entraîne l'inversion : « Never have we lost ».

exercises.audio: Not only did we cut costs, but we also saved time.
options: Not only did we cut costs, but we also saved time.
Not only we cut costs, but we also saved time.
Not only did we cut cost, but we also save time.
Not only did we cut costs, and we also saved time.
exercises.explain: « Not only did we… but we also… » : inversion avec « did » dans la première partie.

exercises.text: What our clients value above all is reliability.
exercises.fr: Ce que nos clients apprécient avant tout, c'est la fiabilité.

author: claude
